steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In October 2024, Equity Mates highlighted Roblox’s scale, citing 79 million daily active users and claims that about half of kids aged 9 to 14 play, while also noting a short report alleging inflated user numbers and weak child safety controls.

episode.title: Seth Klarman's portfolio revealed, the end of obesity is near & is Roblox a "pedophile hellscape"?

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates said Roblox continued to roll out more games and universes on its platform as part of ongoing metaverse-related development.

episode.title: What ever happened to the Metaverse?

views.text: In February 2021, Equity Mates described Roblox’s user-generated platform and strong network effects, with incentives for developers and players and social avatars that could extend into VR as a “co-human environment.”

episode.title: Bonus Episode: Stock Of The Year 2021

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In September 2025, a guest on Equity Mates argued profits were not dropping to the bottom line because costs kept rising to incentivise developers, suggesting competitive pressure and a potentially smaller moat, though noted the platform strategy could help over time.

episode.title: Separating what's real from the hype: Roblox, Games Workshop and more - James Abela | Fidelity

views.text: In October 2024, Equity Mates noted Roblox’s rapid revenue growth, up 110% in 2021 and 26% last year, but said losses were expanding at the same time.

episode.title: Seth Klarman's portfolio revealed, the end of obesity is near & is Roblox a "pedophile hellscape"?

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In September 2025, a guest on Equity Mates highlighted significant share-based compensation to developers causing dilution and said the company generated cash flow but limited profit, which shaped their view of management’s capital allocation.

episode.title: Separating what's real from the hype: Roblox, Games Workshop and more - James Abela | Fidelity

views.text: In February 2021, Equity Mates explained Roblox’s model of incentivising developers to build environments and users to engage, reinvesting in the ecosystem to strengthen the platform’s growth flywheel.

episode.title: Bonus Episode: Stock Of The Year 2021

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In September 2025, a guest on Equity Mates framed Roblox within shifting tech valuations, noting it was nearly a US$100 billion company while losing about US$1 billion a year.

episode.title: Separating what's real from the hype: Roblox, Games Workshop and more - James Abela | Fidelity
